'''Garvimm''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as a [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] vendor on the Sith capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. She was stationed in a small camp near the planet's capital, [[Kaas City]], where she served under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jeelg]].<ref name="TOR" />
